story.overview: Realistic live action in the same connected historic theatre before dawn. Preserve exactly one stage manager, her face, proportions, wardrobe, voice, and every unique prop for the full video.

manager.identity: One middle-aged East Asian female stage manager with one chin-length dark bob, navy-blue work coveralls, a rust-red scarf, brown leather boots, and one calm low adult voice.

theatre.identity: One connected historic theatre before dawn: a narrow backstage corridor with a fixed green door and yellow ladder leads around one corner to a side-stage rope rail, a red velvet curtain, and one wooden stage facing empty burgundy seats.

board.identity: One cobalt-blue clipboard with one silver top clip.

flashlight.identity: One compact brass flashlight with a narrow warm beam when powered on.

shelf.identity: One narrow wooden shelf beside the side-stage rope rail.

rope.identity: One beige curtain rope beside the red velvet curtain.

shots.camera_style: One uninterrupted Steadicam take with one continuous lens and physically plausible walking-speed motion. Preserve camera direction, velocity, theatre geography and screen direction across every window. No cut, reset, teleport, hidden transition or morph.
shots.overall_soundscape: Low ventilation and faint rain on the theatre roof remain continuous. Footsteps change naturally from concrete to hollow wood. Object sounds occur only with visible actions.

camera.composition: A medium-wide frontal view of {{manager}} in the backstage corridor, camera moving backward at her walking speed.
camera.motion: Track backward smoothly; from 00:08.000 begin one continuous shallow left arc with her turn, without changing lens or cutting.
camera.end: Three-quarter frontal view at the corridor corner, still moving through the same left arc.

beats.text: {{manager}} walks steadily down the corridor; {{flashlight}} beam crosses the fixed green door and yellow ladder.
{{manager}} begins the single left turn toward {{rope}}; her feet, body and camera follow the same continuous arc.

dialogue.speaker: manager
dialogue.text: 三号灯位确认，接着检查主幕。

camera.motion: Finish the already visible left arc, settle into a rear three-quarter follow as {{manager}} reaches {{shelf}}, then follow behind her toward the curtain gap without changing lens.
camera.end: Rear three-quarter follow immediately behind {{manager}} as she crosses the curtain gap toward the stage.

beats.text: Continue the turn already in progress until {{manager}} reaches {{shelf}} beside {{rope}}.
{{manager}} places {{flashlight}} once on {{shelf}}, pulls {{rope}} downward once with her freed right hand, then releases it.
She retrieves the same {{flashlight}} and walks through the curtain gap toward the stage while the camera follows continuously.

camera.motion: Continue the rear three-quarter follow onto the wooden stage. After she passes {{stool}}, make one slow continuous lateral arc around her left side; never jump to the opposite angle.
camera.end: Front-left three-quarter medium view four steps downstage from {{stool}}, with the same arc nearly settled.

beats.text: {{manager}} continues through the curtain gap and walks to {{stool}} and {{lamp}}.
She places {{board}} flat on {{stool}}, fully releases it, and switches on {{lamp}} once with her empty left hand.
Leaving {{board}} untouched, {{manager}} walks four measured steps downstage while the camera performs the single continuous lateral arc.

dialogue.speaker: manager
dialogue.text: 主幕顺畅，工作灯也正常。
